records.title: Focusing on Language: Revealing and Exploiting Language Attention Heads in Multilingual Large Language Models
records.reason: The full text scores and analyzes language-specific attention heads and suggests selective activation/pruning, but does not demonstrate deployed inference-time pruning or measured compute/latency/memory gain. The head-gating connection is plausible, but efficiency impact remains unverified.
